Job Description
We are looking for a Senior Staff Inbound Product Manager (IC5) to own product strategy for the ServiceNow SDK and Fluent APIs, the TypeScript-based developer tooling that is becoming the substrate for agentic app development on the Now Platform. ServiceNow Fluent provides a typed, composable, statically analyzed API surface: metadata as code instead of metadata as database records. The SDK is a CLI, a credentialed instance client, and a documentation and agent skills surface designed to be read by coding agents as readily as by people.
This is not a downstream feature team. As a member of NVIDIA's Aerial team, you will architect and implement a GPU ray‑tracing engine that operates at two time scales. At the planning scale, the engine produces volumetric radio maps — coverage, SINR, and best‑server maps at multiple resolutions, composable across cells, frequencies, and beam configurations — that network operators use to design and optimise deployments. At the real‑time scale, the same engine delivers per‑link multipath channel updates at the millisecond cadence that a production RAN stack requires, using adaptive algorithms that exploit temporal coherence to avoid recomputing what hasn't changed. Laying the foundations for real‑time ray tracing on GPU hardware — algorithms, data structures, and multi‑GPU scaling strategies that make sub‑millisecond propagation updates feasible — is the defining technical challenge of this role.

scoringPolicy.deduplication: Distinct kind/scope/pattern or typed selector signatures; one unit allocation per complete required-context group. Repeated occurrences do not add units.
scoringPolicy.limitation: Evaluation-only evidence ranking, not calibrated confidence. Binary false negatives generally score zero; curves cannot recover evidence absent from the production rules. No tuning against this reference run.
scoringPolicy.rationale: One broad lexical match establishes the base rank (0.5). A title-specific or typed-fact match and a complete multi-part context group receive two evidence units (0.75). Additional distinct signatures increase rank with diminishing increments. These are documented ordinal weights, not fitted probabilities or claims of statistical independence.
scoringPolicy.veto: Only accepted rule IDs from the unchanged binary matcher contribute. Exclusion-vetoed concepts, failed context groups, locally negated matches and nonmatches score zero.
